reason: This plugin is primarily an agent orchestration and interactive terminal tool for dsh: it adds a Crew tab with live terminal panes and controls to seat, message, observe, and dismiss AI coding agents in-session. Evidence in the README shows CLI-focused multi-agent workflows (`claude`, `codex`, `dsh`) with job controls and UI streaming, while plugin metadata confirms a web-integrated dsh extension.

summaries.zh: dsh-crew 是一个 dsh 插件，可在 Web 界面中并排展示 Claude Code、Codex 等终端智能体的实时屏幕，并提供工具用于启动、发送任务、观察和结束这些会话。
summaries.en: dsh-crew is a dsh plugin that displays live terminal panes for AI coding agents in the web UI and provides tools to start, message, inspect, and dismiss those sessions.

capabilities: launches and manages interactive PTY-based agent sessions in the operator workspace
streams live terminal screens to a web split-view panel
accepts tool-driven keystroke and message input to running agent sessions
supports background job execution and completion-notification flow for crew tasks
provides session lifecycle controls including dismiss/interrupt behavior

reasons.code: README states each crew member is a real PTY terminal pane in the dsh UI, with tools including crew_list, crew_seat, crew_send, crew_peek, and crew_dismiss.

README describes typing/cancellation behavior (including Ctrl-C), seat/run/send/peek flow, and optional background execution tied to job IDs, showing direct interactive control of running host processes.
README lists a security model around control routes, host/Origin fencing, and WS token-based stream access, indicating exposed runtime control endpoints and active session-bound behavior.
Package metadata marks it as a dsh web plugin with terminal/websocket-related dependencies and headless terminal rendering components.
